fields.title: Cosmology and theory
fields.intro: Inflation and its embedding in fundamental theory, early-universe relics, and the late-time expansion history.

fields.title: Astrophysics and observation
fields.intro: Transient and time-domain signals used as probes of distances, plasmas and planetary systems.

fields.title: Engineering and space systems
fields.intro: Earlier work from my mechanical-engineering training: combustion, heat transfer, structures and space infrastructure.

projects.title: The Kähler stability wall in brane–antibrane inflation
projects.question: How much anti-brane tension can a stabilised Kähler volume tolerate before the vacuum that inflation needs disappears?
projects.summary: An exact analytic boundary on the uplift in perturbative brane–antibrane inflation, where the volume minimum and its decompactification barrier merge at a saddle-node point. The work derives the critical scaling of the modulus mass and barrier height, shows where the single-field description breaks down, and turns the result into necessary conditions on flux data.

projects.title: Inflation under ACT DR6 and DESI DR2
projects.question: How strongly do present CMB and large-scale-structure constraints discriminate among non-minimally coupled inflationary scenarios?
projects.summary: Inflationary observables computed for single-field and non-minimally coupled models, including Jordan–Einstein frame mappings and slow-roll evolution, then scanned against the ACT DR6 and DESI DR2 constraints on the spectral index and tensor-to-scalar ratio.
methods: Parameter scans against ACT DR6 / DESI DR2
projects.institution: Institute of Theoretical Physics, University of Warsaw

projects.title: Primordial black holes and induced gravitational waves in a bounce
projects.question: Can loop-corrected curvature spectra, non-Gaussian collapse and pulsar-timing signals be reconciled within a single non-singular history?
projects.summary: Primordial-black-hole formation and scalar-induced gravitational waves in non-singular bounce scenarios. The analysis tracks how negative non-Gaussianity changes the black-hole abundance and the induced signal in the pulsar-timing band.
projects.institution: Centre for Cosmology and Science Popularization, SGT University

projects.title: Quantum-deformed phase-space geometry and emergent inflation
projects.question: What effective four-dimensional dynamics emerge when gravity is formulated on a quantum-deformed phase-space geometry?
projects.summary: Effective gravitational and inflationary dynamics derived from a deformed Hamiltonian phase space: the induced metric, the equations of motion, and the structure of scalar and tensor perturbations, leading to exact inflationary backgrounds with testable observables.
projects.institution: Future University in Egypt and Egyptian Center for Theoretical Physics

projects.title: Emergent cosmology in causal dissipative f(T) gravity
projects.question: Can causal dissipation in torsion-based gravity support a non-singular emergent branch without an explicit cosmological constant?
projects.summary: Emergent-universe solutions in causal dissipative teleparallel gravity: the dynamical equations, the equilibria of the phase space and their stability, and a comparison of model parameters with supernova and expansion data.

projects.title: An effective running Hubble constant from binned Pantheon data
projects.question: Can redshift-binned supernova data distinguish a genuinely evolving expansion scale from the imprint of the background model?
projects.summary: The redshift dependence of cosmological parameters in Type Ia supernova data, using covariance-aware Bayesian inference, MCMC diagnostics and tests of parameter stability across redshift bins.
projects.institution: National Astronomical Observatory of Japan and ENEA–Sapienza University of Rome

projects.title: Conceptual foundations of spacetime geometry
projects.question: Which conceptual commitments are hidden inside the geometric language used by relativity and cosmology?
projects.summary: Events, intervals and causal structure as a precise starting point for reasoning about relativistic spacetime, developed as an affiliate of the Minkowski Institute.

projects.title: Scintillated binary microlensing of fast radio bursts
projects.question: Can interference in a lensed fast radio burst recover the mass geometry of a compact binary and expose a cosmological distance?
projects.summary: Gravitational lensing of fast radio bursts by compact binaries, using numerical lens inversion and propagation delays, with scintillation-aware forward models. Alongside, an analysis of high-redshift structure in JWST COSMOS-Web data.
projects.institution: Institute of Astronomy, National Tsing Hua University

projects.title: Superluminous supernovae as cosmological probes
projects.question: Can Type Ic superluminous supernovae add useful leverage when standard and modified cosmological backgrounds are compared?
projects.summary: Standard and alternative cosmological models compared using supernova observations, with Bayesian parameter estimation, convergence analysis and model selection.

projects.title: Qatar-1b transit-timing analysis
projects.question: Do the measured transit times of Qatar-1b contain coherent deviations that point beyond a strictly periodic orbit?
projects.summary: Transit photometry, light-curve reduction and timing-residual analysis of the hot Jupiter Qatar-1b over multiple epochs, within the MIT Exoplanet Research Project.

projects.title: Solar radio bursts and coronal plasma diagnostics
projects.question: What can the frequency–time drift of solar radio bursts reveal about density, temperature and turbulent energy transport?
projects.summary: Dynamic radio spectra, dispersion and plasma gradients used to infer coronal conditions, connecting observation with magnetohydrodynamic models of energy transport.

projects.title: Asteroid search and candidate identification
projects.question: How can faint moving candidates be separated from static sky structure precisely enough to become credible objects?
projects.summary: Time-resolved survey images from Pan-STARRS and the Catalina Sky Survey searched for moving solar-system objects, with astrometric measurement and systematic rejection of false candidates.

projects.title: Ammonia–hydrogen combustion and emissions
projects.question: How does hydrogen enrichment reshape flame speed, ignition and nitrogen-oxide formation in ammonia combustion?
projects.summary: Premixed ammonia–hydrogen flames modelled in Python with detailed kinetic mechanisms: laminar flame speeds, ignition delay and the reaction pathways that control NOₓ.
projects.institution: CFD Laboratory, BMS College of Engineering

projects.title: Thermal management for high-power battery cells
projects.question: Can a compact liquid-and-phase-change architecture keep high-power cells inside a narrow thermal window?
projects.summary: Thermal-management concepts for high-power lithium-ion cells combining liquid cooling and phase-change materials, evaluated with conjugate heat-transfer simulation.
projects.institution: Heat Transfer Laboratory, BMS College of Engineering

projects.title: Bio-inspired aeroacoustics of tubercles and serrations
projects.question: Can bio-inspired leading- and trailing-edge geometry reduce airfoil noise without giving up aerodynamic performance?
projects.summary: Undergraduate thesis on airfoils with tubercles and serrations, combining RANS simulation, Ffowcs Williams–Hawkings acoustic analogy and wind-tunnel validation.
projects.institution: Wind Tunnel Laboratory, BMS College of Engineering

projects.title: Power architectures for deep space
projects.question: Which power-conversion architectures remain credible under variable solar flux, planetary shadowing and long radiation exposure?
projects.summary: Conversion efficiency, degradation and fault tolerance as constraints on power systems for long-duration missions, including solar and hybrid solar-sail concepts presented at the International Astronautical Congress.
projects.institution: Deep Space Initiative, Andromeda Research Project

projects.title: Autonomous satellite servicing and hybrid propulsion
projects.question: What combination of servicing autonomy, orbital mechanics and hybrid propulsion could make spacecraft infrastructure less disposable?
projects.summary: Servicing architectures, multi-impulse transfer budgets and combined propulsion concepts for on-orbit repair and the reuse of orbital debris.
projects.institution: Propel Lab 3, BMS College of Engineering

projects.title: Fatigue-resistant lower-limb orthotics
projects.question: How can mass, stiffness, stress concentration and fatigue life be balanced in a lower-limb orthotic structure?
projects.summary: A simulation-driven orthotics project: finite-element stress analysis, fatigue-life prediction and topology optimisation for lighter, more durable assistive structures.
